dataset_name: GCC Location Decision Brief — Evidence-First Prototype Dataset
purpose: Support a transparent prototype comparison of four Indian GCC city candidates. This is a research starter dataset, not a production-grade location recommendation engine.

methodology.approach: Evidence-first. Store source-backed qualitative signals and explicit gaps. Do not fabricate comparable numeric scores.

status_definitions.supported_market_signal: A specific market-level signal is supported by the cited source. It is not automatically a suitability score.
status_definitions.partial: Evidence is relevant but incomplete for the user's exact company profile or criterion.
status_definitions.insufficient: No comparable evidence in this dataset supports a reliable assessment for this criterion.

methodology.scoring_rule: Do not calculate a composite city score if any weighted criterion lacks comparable data. In the current dataset, operating cost, infrastructure/continuity, and launch readiness are insufficient for all cities; therefore, the product must not display a definitive numeric winner.
methodology.shortlist_rule: Present cities as candidates for further evaluation with evidence-backed reasons, not a definitive rank. Show unresolved evidence gaps prominently.
methodology.weighting_note: Illustrative product defaults only. Not a researched benchmark or validated customer preference. The product must show and allow adjustment of weights.
critical_caveats: Market-level leasing is a proxy for ecosystem activity, not talent supply or company-specific suitability.
The company profile's mixed roles are too broad for a precise role-level talent analysis.
Cost must be compared on like-for-like assumptions: role, seniority, compensation components, office grade, micro-market, seat assumptions, fit-out, operating charges, currency, and reference date.
Launch readiness must be assessed through company-specific dependencies and site-specific availability, not inferred from city-level market data.
Policy incentives must not be scored without checking the official policy text and company-specific eligibility.

default_profile.label: Illustrative GCC profile
default_profile.weighting_note: Illustrative product defaults only. Not a researched benchmark or validated customer preference. The product must show and allow adjustment of weights.
interpretation: Mixed roles and multiple functions are too broad to estimate role-specific talent availability confidently.
Cost-sensitive posture makes comparable salary and occupancy-cost data important, but no comparable four-city all-in cost dataset is currently included.
A launch target under six months requires site-specific readiness and setup dependency checks; city-level ecosystem data cannot prove that timeline.
Rapid growth makes scalability relevant, but office leasing and ecosystem growth are proxies rather than direct measures of hiring capacity.

criteria.label: Talent availability
criteria.unit: Qualitative until comparable role-level data exists

criteria.label: Operating cost
criteria.unit: INR per role/year and INR per seat/month, with consistent assumptions

criteria.label: Scalability
criteria.unit: Evidence-backed qualitative signal until comparable measures exist

criteria.label: Industry ecosystem
criteria.unit: Sourced ecosystem signals; not a direct score

criteria.label: Launch readiness
criteria.unit: Company-specific dependency checklist and dated plan

cities.name: Bengaluru
cities.market_position: Established, high-activity GCC and technology market

talent_availability.signal: Strong technology-market signal; Colliers also identifies Bengaluru as a leading domestic/operational financial-services centre.
talent_availability.decision_implication: Worth evaluating if the final role mix includes substantial technology or financial-services roles.
talent_availability.limitations: Does not prove availability, salary, hiring speed, or retention for the exact mixed role family. Role mix must be specified before scoring.

operating_cost.signal: No comparable all-in cost figures for this exact under-100, mixed-function GCC profile are included in this dataset.
operating_cost.decision_implication: Request like-for-like salary and occupancy estimates using the same roles, seniority, office grade, space assumptions, and date.
operating_cost.limitations: Do not infer total cost from broad market reputation or office leasing volume. Rent alone is not total operating cost.

industry_ecosystem.signal: Bengaluru is a leading GCC leasing market; ORR, Whitefield, and North Bengaluru are identified as GCC micro-markets. Bengaluru recorded 22.1 million sq ft of Grade A office leasing in 2025 in Colliers' cited top-seven-city coverage.
industry_ecosystem.decision_implication: A credible candidate when the company values a deep, established GCC and technology ecosystem.
industry_ecosystem.limitations: Leasing volume measures market activity, not suitability for every company or guaranteed access to suitable space.

infrastructure_continuity.signal: No consistently measured, comparable city-level continuity dataset is included.
infrastructure_continuity.decision_implication: Validate the specific office micro-market, commute patterns, power/connectivity redundancy, and business-continuity requirements during due diligence.
infrastructure_continuity.limitations: Do not turn broad city stereotypes into a score.

scalability.signal: Large established GCC leasing market and multiple recognised GCC micro-markets.
scalability.decision_implication: Market depth is a positive signal for future expansion, but hiring plans and office options still need to be tested.
scalability.limitations: Market-wide leasing does not prove that this company can scale its exact roles at its target cost.

launch_readiness.signal: No evidence in this dataset proves a six-month launch is achievable.
launch_readiness.decision_implication: Check entity, hiring, office, security, IT, vendor, and compliance dependencies against a dated implementation plan.
launch_readiness.limitations: A city choice alone cannot guarantee a launch timeline.

cities.city_summary: Strongest established-market signal in this dataset, particularly for technology and broad GCC ecosystem access. Cost and launch feasibility remain unproven for this specific company.

cities.name: Hyderabad
cities.market_position: Established GCC and technology market with significant office development

talent_availability.signal: Strong technology-market signal; Colliers describes Hyderabad as an emerging domestic operational centre for financial services.
talent_availability.decision_implication: Worth evaluating for technology and selected business-operation roles once the role mix is specified.
talent_availability.limitations: Does not prove availability or cost for every role family in a mixed-function GCC.

operating_cost.signal: No comparable all-in cost figures for this exact company profile are included.
operating_cost.decision_implication: Compare the same role/seniority salary basket and equivalent office assumptions against the other shortlisted cities.
operating_cost.limitations: Do not label Hyderabad the cheapest city without like-for-like current data.

industry_ecosystem.signal: Bengaluru and Hyderabad together account for over 60% of GCC leasing since 2021 in Colliers' cited coverage. SBD and Off-SBD are recognised GCC/technology micro-markets.
industry_ecosystem.decision_implication: A credible candidate for an established GCC ecosystem and technology-related capabilities.
industry_ecosystem.limitations: Combined leasing share is not Hyderabad's individual share and does not imply fit for all functions.

infrastructure_continuity.signal: No consistent, comparable city-level operational continuity measure is included.
infrastructure_continuity.decision_implication: Validate the proposed micro-market, commute catchment, utilities, connectivity, and site-specific continuity provisions.
infrastructure_continuity.limitations: Do not infer a city-wide score from general reputation.

scalability.signal: Established GCC leasing activity and substantial office development pipeline; CBRE reports Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Pune together accounted for 64% of 2025 new office completions.
scalability.decision_implication: A positive market-depth signal to investigate for rapid growth.
scalability.limitations: The combined figure does not isolate Hyderabad's contribution or prove immediately available space at the required scale and budget.

launch_readiness.signal: No evidence in this dataset proves a six-month launch is achievable.
launch_readiness.decision_implication: Confirm local entity and compliance requirements, hiring lead times, suitable office availability, and vendor mobilisation.
launch_readiness.limitations: Policy or market activity alone cannot establish launch readiness.

cities.city_summary: Strong established GCC and technology ecosystem signal. Cost advantage and six-month launch feasibility need direct, comparable validation.

cities.name: Chennai
cities.market_position: Established office market with rising GCC leasing momentum and engineering/manufacturing relevance

talent_availability.signal: Colliers describes Chennai as increasingly relevant to engineering and manufacturing GCCs; financial-services research also identifies Chennai as an emerging domestic operational centre.
talent_availability.decision_implication: Worth evaluating if the final role mix includes engineering, manufacturing-related capabilities, or selected operations roles.
talent_availability.limitations: The user's mixed role family is not specific enough to estimate availability across all needed occupations.

operating_cost.signal: No comparable all-in cost figures for the exact company profile are included.
operating_cost.decision_implication: Test the cost hypothesis using same-date role-level salary estimates and equivalent occupancy options.
operating_cost.limitations: Do not assume a city is cheaper based on broad commentary; total cost includes more than rent.

industry_ecosystem.signal: Colliers reports Chennai's GCC leasing in 2025 was approximately four times its 2021 level, and identifies OMR/MPR/PTR among key GCC micro-markets.
industry_ecosystem.decision_implication: A credible candidate to evaluate, particularly for engineering/manufacturing-related needs and a diversified GCC mandate.
industry_ecosystem.limitations: Growth from a base does not establish absolute scale, role fit, or cost competitiveness for this company.

infrastructure_continuity.signal: No consistent, comparable city-level continuity dataset is included.
infrastructure_continuity.decision_implication: Validate the chosen micro-market, employee commute catchment, power/connectivity redundancy, and business-continuity requirements.
infrastructure_continuity.limitations: Do not infer operational reliability from leasing growth.

scalability.signal: Strong recent GCC leasing growth provides a positive momentum signal; key GCC micro-markets are identified by Colliers.
scalability.decision_implication: Worth investigating for future growth, while testing depth for each required role family.
scalability.limitations: Growth in leasing does not directly measure the ability to recruit a mixed workforce rapidly.

launch_readiness.signal: No evidence in this dataset proves a six-month launch is achievable.
launch_readiness.decision_implication: Validate specific office availability, local hiring capacity, legal/compliance dependencies, and implementation timeline.
launch_readiness.limitations: A rising GCC market is not a launch-readiness guarantee.

cities.city_summary: Strong recent GCC growth signal and relevant engineering/manufacturing ecosystem. Do not assume a cost advantage or broad mixed-role talent fit without comparable data.

cities.name: Pune
cities.market_position: Established office market with technology, engineering/manufacturing, and selected financial-services activity

talent_availability.signal: Pune appears among India's notable financial-services talent locations in Colliers' 2026 report; Colliers also identifies Pune as an established technology office market.
talent_availability.decision_implication: Worth evaluating for technology, engineering/manufacturing, and selected financial-services support roles once the role mix is specified.
talent_availability.limitations: These sector signals do not establish role-by-role availability, salary, or time-to-hire for a mixed GCC.

operating_cost.signal: No comparable all-in cost figures for this exact company profile are included.
operating_cost.decision_implication: Request a same-date salary basket and equivalent office/managed-space cost assumptions for all four cities.
operating_cost.limitations: Do not infer lower total operating cost from market position alone.

industry_ecosystem.signal: Kharadi is identified as a GCC micro-market; Pune is included among India's major technology office markets and appears in the financial-services talent research.
industry_ecosystem.decision_implication: A credible candidate where the final role mix aligns with its technology, engineering, or selected financial-services ecosystem.
industry_ecosystem.limitations: Market presence does not prove a fit for every role family or budget.

infrastructure_continuity.signal: No consistent, comparable city-level continuity dataset is included.
infrastructure_continuity.decision_implication: Validate the proposed micro-market, employee commute patterns, utilities, connectivity, and business-continuity needs.
infrastructure_continuity.limitations: Do not turn general city reputation into a score.

scalability.signal: Pune is an established office market; Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune together accounted for 64% of new office completions in 2025 according to CBRE.
scalability.decision_implication: A positive office-market depth signal, subject to verifying suitable options and talent for the planned expansion.
scalability.limitations: The combined statistic does not isolate Pune's contribution or prove that a specific office is available.

launch_readiness.signal: No evidence in this dataset proves a six-month launch is achievable.
launch_readiness.decision_implication: Validate role-level hiring, specific office availability, entity/compliance tasks, and supplier readiness.
launch_readiness.limitations: Office market activity is not proof of an achievable launch timeline.

cities.city_summary: Credible alternative for selected technology, engineering, and financial-services roles. Mixed-role talent fit, total cost, and launch readiness remain unproven.

sources.title: GCCs in India: Global leadership through scale, competitiveness, talent & innovation
supports: Bengaluru and Hyderabad account for over 60% of GCC leasing since 2021.
Chennai recorded approximately fourfold growth in GCC leasing in 2025 compared with 2021.
Bengaluru ORR and Hyderabad SBD are leading GCC micro-markets.
BFSI and Engineering & Manufacturing are significant GCC leasing demand contributors.
Key GCC micro-markets include Bengaluru ORR/Whitefield/North Bengaluru, Hyderabad SBD/Off-SBD, Chennai OMR/MPR/PTR, and Pune Kharadi.
sources.limitations: Leasing activity is a proxy for ecosystem activity, not a direct measure of talent availability, total operating cost, or launch readiness. The report focuses on Grade A office leasing and defined city coverage.

sources.title: India Office Figures Q4 2025
supports: India office leasing reached 82.6 million sq ft in 2025.
Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Delhi-NCR accounted for about 61% of total office take-up.
Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune accounted for a cumulative 64% of new office completions in 2025.
GCCs accounted for 39% of office absorption in Q4 2025.
sources.limitations: National and city-market signals do not establish the cost or availability of a specific office for a small GCC. Office completions are not equivalent to immediately suitable, available, or affordable space.

sources.title: Global Tech Markets: Top Talent Locations 2025
supports: Bengaluru is identified as a leading global technology talent market.
India has several strong technology talent markets across the APAC region.
sources.limitations: The published overview does not provide directly comparable occupation-by-occupation data for this specific mixed-function company profile. Do not use it to generate numerical city talent scores.

sources.title: India Financial Services Talent Hub Report 2026
supports: Bengaluru is identified as a leading domestic and operational financial-services centre.
Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai are described as emerging domestic operational centres for financial services.
The report's labour index incorporates talent-pool size, talent density, and open job posts.
sources.limitations: This is financial-services-specific. It cannot stand in for a mixed role-family assessment or establish hiring feasibility for the user's exact job mix.

sources.title: India Office Leasing Crosses 70 MSF in 2025
supports: Bengaluru recorded 22.1 million sq ft of Grade A office leasing in 2025.
Bengaluru accounted for nearly one-third of pan-India office leasing activity in the cited top-seven-city market.
sources.limitations: Leasing demand is an ecosystem signal, not a direct indicator of rent affordability, availability of small office suites, or the ability to launch within six months.

sources.title: Technology Sector Office Demand India 2025
supports: Bengaluru and Hyderabad together account for nearly half of technology leasing over the preceding five years.
Pune and Chennai are also established technology office markets.
The source identifies key technology micro-markets in Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Chennai.
sources.limitations: Technology leasing is not a substitute for a role-level talent benchmark or an all-functions GCC suitability score.

sources.publisher: Directorate of ICT & e-Governance, Government of Gujarat
sources.title: Gujarat GCC Policy 2025–30
supports: An official state GCC policy exists for Gujarat.
sources.limitations: Not used to score the four-city shortlist. Policy availability does not imply eligibility, and eligibility depends on policy text and company-specific facts.

sources.publisher: Industries, Investment and Services Department, Government of Maharashtra
sources.title: Maharashtra policies index (includes GCC Policy 2025 and operational guidelines)
supports: Maharashtra's official policy index lists a GCC Policy 2025 and operational guidelines.
sources.limitations: A policy index alone does not establish eligibility or the value of an incentive for an individual company.

current_profile_result.result_type: evidence-led candidate set, not a ranked winner
current_profile_result.reason: The profile requests multiple functions and mixed roles, while comparable role-level talent data, like-for-like all-in cost data, infrastructure-continuity data, and launch-readiness data are not available in this dataset.
next_inputs_to_improve_confidence: Specify the top two or three functions and priority role families.
Define seniority mix and target hiring volume per role family.
Set a consistent office model and space assumption.
Obtain same-period, like-for-like salary and occupancy estimates.
Define what the six-month launch must include and which dependencies are already completed.
